player.name: V Mehra
player.placeOfBirth: New York, United States of America

items.html:
The grand-nephew of well-known Delhi player and administrator Ram
Prakash  Mehra,  Vijay  Mehra  has cricket in his blood. He first
went to the UAE along with his Embassy-employed father in   1986,
and  having  liked it so much, opted to settle down there. During
his time in Delhi, he captained St. Stephen`s College  in  Delhi,
played in the U-22 Cooch Behar and CK Nayudu tournaments in India
and at times even opened the innings with Navjot Sidhu.  Once  in
the   UAE,  he  soon  earned  his national  call-up and has since
represented the region with dignity, lending a neccesary solidity
to the middle order. The crowning feather in his cap thus far was
the opportunity to lead the UAE against India `A` in  the  recent
Interface Cup tournament in Sharjah.
